say:1:1130715001:1.text: She's playing with her friends. It's been a while since they've been able to, so of course they quarreled at first and made up five minutes later. Ha, kids...
say:1:1130715001:1.source_cn: 去和朋友们玩了，他们那么久没见，先是大吵一架，过几分钟...

say:2:1130715002:1.text: I never told her the truth. Those kids are too young to understand what happened.
say:2:1130715002:1.source_cn: 我始终没有告诉女儿真相，那些孩子们年纪小，也没明白之前...

say:3:1130715003:1.text: It's not a bad thing though. Hopefully, time will help them forget it all together.
say:3:1130715003:1.source_cn: 这样也好，或许再过几年，他们就会把这段糟糕的经历忘了吧。
